name: Zenra de Onsen Reporter o Saserareta Tsuma
original_name: 全裸で温泉レポーターをさせられた妻
source:
The main character's wife was once a popular broadcaster.
Since the marriage, her appearance on TV became rare.
Then, she accepted an offer from a notorious production company.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054708.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
主角的妻子曾经是一位受欢迎的播音员。
自从结婚之后，她就很少在电视上露面了。
然后，她接受了一家臭名昭著的制作公司的邀请。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE054708.html]DLsite English[/url]]
